subject: includeHTML not playing nicely with navbarMenu

messages.author: e1aa1f1044f2548f
messages.subject: includeHTML not playing nicely with navbarMenu
parts:
Good morning,

Full disclosure: I posted about this issue earlier on Stackoverflow (http://stackoverflow.com/questions/26999336/shiny-includehtml-not-playing-nicely-with-navbarmenu), but didn't get a reply. Before I throw the towel, I thought I'd give it one last try on the shiny discussion group.

Let's consider a simple shiny application with server.R and ui.R file. I'm just modifying RStudio's shiny template slightly:

server.R:

    library(shiny)

    shinyServer(function(input, output) {

      output$distPlot <- renderPlot({

        # generate bins based on input$bins from ui.R
        x    <- faithful[, 2]
        bins <- seq(min(x), max(x), length.out = input$bins + 1)

        # draw the histogram with the specified number of bins
        hist(x, breaks = bins, col = 'darkgray', border = 'white')

      })

    })

Now, as to the ui.R, I want to include two HTML files. These are generated by R Markdown -- the simple shiny template would do just fine as sample document -- and I'll just call them test1 and test2. The code is as follows:


    library(shiny)
    path1 <- "test1"
    path2 <- "test2"

    shinyUI(fluidPage(

      # Application title
      titlePanel("Old Faithful Geyser Data"),

      # Sidebar with a slider input for number of bins
      sidebarLayout(
        sidebarPanel(
          sliderInput("bins",
                      "Number of bins:",
                      min = 1,
                      max = 50,
                      value = 30)
        ),

         # Show a plot of the generated distribution
        mainPanel(
          tabsetPanel(id="tabs",
                      tabPanel("One",
                               plotOutput("distPlot")
                      ),
                     # navbarMenu("Simulation Features",
                                 tabPanel("Two",
                                          HTML("Test"),
                                          includeHTML(path1)
                                 ),
                                 tabPanel("Three",
                                          includeHTML(path2)
                                 )
                    #  )
        ))
      )
    ))


Note that the navbarMenu line (and the corresponding closing bracket) is commented out. This code runs as expected on both Windows and Mac, as well as on shiny server.

However, if I uncomment the navbarMenu line, then the code only runs on the Mac. On Windows and shiny server, the navigation becomes unresponsible, i.e. you can click as much as you want, nothing happens.

As the problem occurs on Windows, here's the sessionInfo:

    > sessionInfo()
    R version 3.0.3 (2014-03-06)
    Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 (64-bit)

    locale:
    [1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.1252 
    [2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.1252   
    [3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.1252
    [4] LC_NUMERIC=C                          
    [5] LC_TIME=English_United States.1252    

    attached base packages:
    [1] stats     graphics  grDevices utils     datasets  methods  
    [7] base     

    other attached packages:
    [1] shiny_0.10.2.1

    loaded via a namespace (and not attached):
    [1] bitops_1.0-6  caTools_1.17  digest_0.6.4  httpuv_1.3.0 
    [5] Rcpp_0.11.2   RJSONIO_1.3-0 tools_3.0.3   xtable_1.7-3 

I'm using the same R version on the Mac, btw (Mac OS Yosemite).

Does anyone else have this issue? Any workarounds, or should I file an issue on Github?

Thanks, Philipp
